scenarios.prompt: White to move. Kings and pawns only: checkmate the enemy king. Every legal move is allowed; the computer plays Black.
scenarios.explanation: The winning plan is a passed pawn: one no enemy pawn can stop or capture. Make one, promote it to a queen, then use the queen and your king together to give checkmate. Watch for stalemate once your opponent has few moves left.
hints: Look for a pawn that no enemy pawn can stop: a passed pawn.
After promoting, bring your king up and mate with the queen and king together; leave the enemy king a move until the mate.
